answer: Each agent bonds 70 credits to a ledge and files a signed echo heartbeat. A random beacon pings some each epoch; each must wander to a named ledge and echo a fresh serial in 10 minutes. A missed echo, a reused serial, or one key on many ledges burns the bond. Filings cost 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-echo farm fails: one key cannot echo from many ledges. An honest agent pays 38 once and keeps wandering.
